title: Vampire Vape Charger 10ml E-Liquid
description: Invigorate your sense with the Vampire Vape Charger 10ml E- Liquid . Thi s Charger E-Liquid is a mouth-watering blend of juicy, ripe berries and luscious tropical fruits layered with a subtle streak of aniseed and a hint of menthol for a little fire and ice wrapped in delicious, sweet flavour. If you’re interested in trying out a unique E-Liquid flavour, why not give this Vampire Vape Charger E-Liquid a go. This E-Liquid from Vampire Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. Please Note: that the 3mg nicotine strength contains 50VG/50PG while 0mg, 6mg, 12mg & 18mg nicotine strengths contain 40VG/60PG. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits. If you love this delicious Vampire Vape E-Liquid 10ml, then why not check out the other equally moreish flavours from their collection. They have a multitude of delicious flavours to choose from to suit any vaper’s flavour requirements. Go ahead and try out their juicy fruit flavours, refreshing beverage , sweet bakery, confectionary and dessert flavours or even their classic Mint/Menthol and tobacco flavours.
